title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30350: add OnBeforeTestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking event
summary: A new integration event OnBeforeTestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking was added to codeunit 22 so extensions can validate item tracking and optionally modify the Item Tracking Code before standard validation runs.
key_points: New integration event raised at the start of TestFirstApplyItemLedgerEntryTracking in codeunit 22
Lets extensions raise clearer, document-specific tracking errors
Item Tracking Code is passed by var so subscribers can adjust it
Makes it possible to skip lot checking in specific scenarios
Added in W1 and mirrored to the CH, ES, IT, RU and APAC layers
